run_sample_reconstruction: run the sample reconstruction script to reconstruct ImageNet validation images using a MetaQueryPipeline checkpoint
run_sample_metaquery: run the sample_metaquery function to generate reconstructed images from a MetaQueryPipeline and a batch of preprocessed images
run_main_pipeline: run the main function to load a checkpoint, process an ImageNet dataset slice, and save reconstructed images
review_preprocess_image: review the preprocess_image transform that converts images to RGB, resizes to 384, and center crops
review_sample_metaquery: review the sample_metaquery function that calls the pipeline with guidance scales and inference steps
